description: A model's, or the asking Bot's, answer to an ask (Route to → Have a model answer; a Bot's answer_ask after the person wrote to it): shown for the person to confirm or change, taking effect only as they press a button.

model.description: The model's value (a Bot's: its name).

name.description: The model or Bot, as it's named.

status.description: answering: it's being asked; ready: its answer's here; failed: it couldn't answer (text: why).

button.description: The button it would press (its index), once it's answered.

values.description: The form's values as it would fill them.

text.description: Why, in a line or two (or why it failed).
